title: Archidocs project.yaml

id.description: The Project's id, unique in the Workspace. Other Projects write it as the prefix of a Qualified id, such as `payments:ledger`.

owner.description: The Team that owns the Project: the id of a Team in `workspace.yaml`. It is the Owner of every Element and Deployment Target in the Project that sets no `owner` of its own.

description: `project.yaml`: marks its folder as a Project.
